user.title: Connect to Alfred Black
user.description: Point this Home Assistant at an Alfred tenant. Mint a channel token from `/study` (or `POST /api/v1/channel-tokens/mint` with channel `ha-conversation`) and paste it below.

data_description.channel_token: Starts with `ha_` followed by 48 hex characters.

error.invalid_url: Base URL must be a full https://… or http://… address.
error.invalid_token_shape: Channel token must start with `ha_` followed by 48 hex characters.
error.invalid_auth: Alfred rejected the token. Mint a fresh one from /study and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Alfred at that URL. Check the host and your network (Tailscale, etc.).

abort.already_configured: This Alfred tenant is already connected to Home Assistant.
